record.reference: Grupo Simec effected a 3-for-1 split of its Mexican ordinary shares on 2006-05-30 while simultaneously changing the U.S. ADR ratio from one ADR per ordinary share to one ADR per three ordinary shares. The depositary states that outstanding ADR count and U.S. ADR price were unaffected, so the canonical multiplier for U.S.-traded SIM is 1.0.
